description: Given a list of integers operations, return a pair (s, neg). s is the list of running totals: it has one more element than operations, s[0] is 0, and s[i + 1] == s[i] + operations[i] for every index i of operations. neg is true if some running total after the initial 0 is negative, and false if all running totals are non-negative. An empty operations list gives ([0], false).
notes: The existential (some running total after the initial 0 is negative) is stated in Dafny with the recursive predicate HasNegativeFrom(result.0, 1) ({:fuel 10}) so that Dafny can decide it on concrete outputs. The Python spec keeps VERINA's form.
